
If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time." Also "You should only make one tool call at a time". The agent made two tool calls without any user response in between. That's a violation: making more than one tool call at a time. So the suspicion of policy_violation is confirmed.

We need to output JSON with verdict CONFIRMED, reason, confidence, used_graph_evidence.

We should verify using the digest? The digest includes observed values but not directly about the tool calls. However we can still use it; but we need to verify ourselves from full context. The full context shows two tool calls in same turn. So violation.
